paragraphs.en: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories, but a single trajectory realizes only one continuation at each decision, limiting supervision coverage under a finite sampling budget. We propose BranchOPD (Branching On-Policy Distillation) , which selects informative decision points using student uncertainty and teacher–student disagreement, resamples student-policy continuations from shared prefixes, and applies token-level teacher supervision to both main trajectories and branches. BranchOPD operates at token-level decisions in mathematics and within-turn decisions in agent tasks. Shared-prefix reuse reduces student-generated token costs by approximately 19% on ALFWorld and 31% on WebShop relative to seven independent trajectories. We also introduce protocol-boundary repair (PBR), which uses targeted supervision under protocol constraints to mitigate repetition and wasted generation. BranchOPD outperforms Vanilla OPD and Multi-Rollout OPD ( n = 7 n=7 ) across all evaluated benchmarks, with gains over Vanilla OPD of 18.55 percentage points in mean mathematics accuracy over 16 sampled answers (avg@16) and 13.8 points in mean ALFWorld ID/OOD success. Mechanistic analyses and selection ablations show that branching at uncertain decisions expands subsequent behavior coverage and outperforms random selection and turn-initial branching.

paragraphs.en: Distillation is a standard way to transfer the reasoning and interaction abilities of a large language model to a smaller one. Training on fixed teacher outputs ( Hinton et al., 2015 ; Kim and Rush, 2016 ) exposes the student only to prefixes the teacher would write, whereas at inference the student must continue from its own. On-policy distillation (OPD) closes this gap: the student generates trajectories and the teacher scores every generated token ( Agarwal et al., 2023 ; Ross et al., 2010 ; Bengio et al., 2015 ; Gu et al., 2023 ; Ko et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 蒸馏是一种将大型语言模型的推理和交互能力迁移到小型模型的标准方法。 在固定教师输出上进行训练（Hinton 等，2015；Kim 和 Rush，2016）会使学生仅接触到教师会写的前缀，而在推理阶段，学生必须从自身生成的内容开始继续生成。 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）填补了这一差距：学生生成轨迹，而教师对每个生成的词元进行评分（Agarwal 等，2023；Ross 等，2010；Bengio 等，2015；Gu 等，2023；Ko 等，2024）。

paragraphs.en: Each trajectory, however, follows only one of the continuations available at every decision. Even with the teacher’s full next-token distribution at a prefix, the student receives no supervision on the multi-step histories that the unchosen tokens would have led to. This matters in mathematical reasoning, where an early step constrains the rest of the derivation, and in agent tasks, where an action changes all later observations ( Yao et al., 2022b ; Schick et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2022b ; Wei et al., 2022 ; Qin et al., 2023 ) . Sampling more independent trajectories widens coverage, but most of the extra tokens regenerate identical or near-identical prefixes. As Figure 1 shows, resampling from a single prefix can reach quite different paths, sometimes even when the first resampled token matches the original.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，每条轨迹在每个决策点都只遵循可用延续中的其中一种。 即便在给定前缀的情况下，教师模型提供了完整的下一个词元分布，学生模型仍然无法获得关于那些未被选择的词元本应导向的多步历史信息的任何监督。 这一点在数学推理中至关重要，因为早期的步骤会限制后续推导的走向；在智能体任务中也同样重要，因为一个行动会改变之后所有的观察结果（Yao et al., 2022b ; Schick et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2022b ; Wei et al., 2022 ; Qin et al., 2023）。 采样更多独立的轨迹可以扩大覆盖范围，但大多数额外的词元都会再生成相同或近乎相同的前缀。 如图1所示，从单个前缀进行重新采样可以通向截然不同的路径，有时即使第一个重新采样的词元与原始词元一致，也会出现这种情况。

paragraphs.en: Recent OPD methods decide where to spend supervision on trajectories that have already been sampled: they reweight tokens, reasoning steps, or turns ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Zhong et al., 2026 ; Tan et al., 2026 ; Sheng et al., 2026 ) , order trajectories by difficulty ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , or reuse teacher-scored samples ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . We ask instead which additional trajectories to sample. Tree search and branching reinforcement learning already share prefixes to explore locally ( Li et al., 2025 ; Dong et al., 2025 ; Zong et al., 2026 ; Ji et al., 2025 ; Yao et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2023a ; Hao et al., 2023 ; Khomich et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026c ; He et al., 2026 ) ; we bring this idea to distillation, where every branch token receives dense teacher supervision and no task reward is needed.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的 OPD 方法决定在哪些已采样的轨迹上分配监督：它们会重新加权标记、推理步骤或回合（Xu et al., 2026；Zhong et al., 2026；Tan et al., 2026；Sheng et al., 2026），按难度对轨迹排序（Wang et al., 2026b），或重用由教师模型评分的样本（Zheng et al., 2026）。 我们转而提出一个问题：应该采样哪些额外的轨迹？ 树搜索和分支强化学习已经共享前缀以实现局部探索（Li et al., 2025；Dong et al., 2025；Zong et al., 2026；Ji et al., 2025；Yao et al., 2023；Zhou et al., 2023a；Hao et al., 2023；Khomich et al., 2026；Yu et al., 2026c；He et al., 2026）；我们将这一思想引入蒸馏领域，其中每个分支标记都获得密集的教师模型监督，且无需任务奖励。

paragraphs.en: We propose BranchOPD. For each input, the student first generates a main trajectory. We then pick a few fork points using student uncertainty and teacher–student disagreement, and sample new continuations from the frozen student policy at each fork. In mathematics tasks, we select token positions directly; in agent tasks we first select turns and then positions within them. The teacher scores all generated tokens on the main trajectory and the branches, and a shared prefix enters the loss only once. Because branches come from the student rather than from the teacher or a refined trajectory ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) , they stay on the student’s own distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 BranchOPD。 对于每个输入，学生智能体首先生成一条主轨迹。 接着，我们利用学生智能体的不确定性和师生智能体之间的分歧来选择几个分叉点，并在每个分叉点从冻结的学生策略中采样新的延续路径。 在数学任务中，我们直接选择词元位置；而在智能体任务中，我们首先选择回合，再选择回合内的位置。 教师智能体对主轨迹和分支上所有生成的词元进行评分，且共享前缀仅被计入损失一次。 由于分支来自学生智能体，而非教师智能体或优化后的轨迹（Jiang et al., 2026; Zhou et al., 2026），因此它们仍保持在学生智能体自身的分布范围内。

paragraphs.en: A commonly encountered failure mode in OPD is improper termination: the student may continue generating after producing the final answer, often emitting redundant content or stray formatting tokens ( Yang et al., 2026b ; Luo et al., 2026 ) . We handle this problem by protocol-boundary repair (PBR), an auxiliary loss on detected protocol events, and apply PBR to the baselines so that comparisons isolate the effect of branching.
paragraphs.zh: OPD 中一种常见的失效模式是终止不当：学生在生成最终答案后可能会继续生成内容，通常会输出冗余内容或离散的格式标记（Yang et al., 2026b；Luo et al., 2026）。 我们通过协议边界修复（PBR）来解决这个问题，这是一种针对检测到的协议事件施加的辅助损失函数，并将 PBR 应用于基线模型，以便比较能够单独分析分支的影响。

paragraphs.en: GKD, MiniLLM, and DistiLLM train students on their own samples and study which divergence to minimize ( Agarwal et al., 2023 ; Gu et al., 2023 ; Ko et al., 2024 ) . Reasoning supervision can also come from solution selection, process feedback, or explanations ( Lightman et al., 2023 ; Zelikman et al., 2022 ; Hsieh et al., 2023 ) . More recent OPD methods reweight supervision across tokens ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Sheng et al., 2026 ) , reasoning steps ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) , or interaction turns ( Tan et al., 2026 ) , or schedule trajectories by difficulty ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . EOPD adds a forward-KL term at tokens where the teacher has high entropy ( Jin et al., 2026 ) , and other work reformulates the target or constrains the update ( Jang et al., 2026 ; Ko et al., 2026 ) . Closest to ours, SPOT forces teacher-proposed tokens at selected positions, scores the resulting student continuations with an outcome verifier, and distills a calibrated local target ( Qu et al., 2026 ) . In BranchOPD, branches are sampled from the student itself and supervised token by token, without task rewards.

paragraphs.en: Probability mismatch and degenerate agreement motivate studies of what makes OPD supervision useful ( Yu et al., 2026d ; Xin et al., 2026 ; Armandpour et al., 2026 ) . Trajectory refinement and expert corrections improve the examples shown to the student ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Lauffer et al., 2025 ) , and teacher continuations from student anchors extend supervision beyond sampled rollouts ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) ; our continuations come from the student. Our objective is token-local and complements work that separates token-level updates from sequence-level credit assignment ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . PBR follows unlikelihood training ( Welleck et al., 2019 ) in supervising specific output events.

For the agent tasks, the student is Qwen3-4B; the teacher is Qwen3-30B-A3B on ALFWorld and a GRPO-trained checkpoint of the same model on WebShop and Search-QA. To test other student sizes and model families, we also distill Qwen3-4B into Qwen3-1.7B, and Qwen2.5-7B-RL into Qwen2.5-3B on ALFWorld. Benchmarks, prompts, and hyperparameters are described in Appendices E , G , and D .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在数学推理和三个智能体基准测试上进行评估。 在数学任务中，我们基于 DAPO-Math-17K（Yang et al., 2025；Yu et al., 2025）将 Qwen3-8B 蒸馏为 Qwen3-4B-Base。 对于智能体任务，学生模型是 Qwen3-4B；教师模型在 ALFWorld 上是 Qwen3-30B-A3B，在 WebShop 和 Search-QA 上则是同一模型的 GRPO 训练检查点。 为了测试其他规模的学生模型和不同的模型系列，我们还基于 ALFWorld 将 Qwen3-4B 蒸馏为 Qwen3-1.7B，并将 Qwen2.5-7B-RL 蒸馏为 Qwen2.5-3B。 基准测试、提示词和超参数在附录 E、G 和 D 中有详细说明。

paragraphs.en: For mathematics, we report avg@16, the accuracy averaged over 16 sampled answers per problem, on MATH-500, AIME 2024, and AIME 2025. paragraphs.en: While achieving broader behavior coverage, BranchOPD requires fewer student-generated tokens by reusing the prefix shared with the main trajectory. On ALFWorld, one trajectory requires 2,813 student tokens on average; seven independent trajectories would therefore require 19,691 tokens, whereas our seven-trajectory branching setting uses only 15,924 tokens, saving 19.1%. On WebShop, the corresponding cost is 4,824 tokens versus 7,014 for seven independent trajectories, saving 31.2% (Figure 3 ; Table 11 ). These counts exclude teacher scoring, backpropagation, and environment replay.

paragraphs.en: PBR explicitly controls protocol events that should either be encouraged or suppressed. For example, it encourages termination after a complete mathematical answer by setting (C= EOS \mathrm{EOS} ) and (b=1), while suppressing extra leading closing-thought tags in agent responses with (b=0). On mathematics, PBR alone lifts Vanilla OPD from 25.82 to 38.94 Avg (Table 1 ) and leaves more room below the length limit (Figure 4 ). On ALFWorld, it improves ID/OOD SR by 7.14/5.97 points and removes the extra leading tags entirely. A teacher that does not repeat in its own rollouts can still reinforce repetition when conditioned on a repetitive student prefix, so the repair must act on student prefixes (Appendix B.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: PBR 明确控制协议事件，这些事件应当被鼓励或抑制。 例如，通过设置 (C= EOS \mathrm{EOS} ) 和 (b=1)，PBR 会鼓励在给出完整数学答案后终止响应；而通过设置 (b=0)，则会抑制智能体响应中多余的开头闭合思想标签。 在数学任务中，仅使用 PBR 就能将 Vanilla OPD 的平均得分从 25.82 提升至 38.94（表 1），同时为长度限制留下了更多余量（图 4）。 在 ALFWorld 中，PBR 将 ID/OOD SR 提升了 7.14/5.97 分，并完全消除了多余的开头标签。 即使教师模型在其自身的推理过程中不重复内容，当以重复的学生前缀为条件时，它仍可能强化重复行为，因此修复必须针对学生前缀进行（附录 B.5）。

paragraphs.en: We presented BranchOPD, which resamples student continuations at selected decision points to broaden on-policy distillation, together with protocol-boundary repair. It outperforms Vanilla OPD and Multi-Rollout OPD on every evaluated benchmark while generating fewer student tokens than independent rollouts. What a student learns from OPD depends not only on the teacher signal but also on which of its own alternative histories it gets to see.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 BranchOPD，该方法通过在选定的决策点对学生模型的续写进行重采样，以扩展策略内蒸馏，并结合了协议边界修复。 在所有评估的基准测试中，BranchOPD 的表现均优于 Vanilla OPD 和 Multi-Rollout OPD，同时生成的学生模型词元数量少于独立展开方法。 学生模型从 OPD 中学到的内容不仅取决于教师信号，还取决于它能够看到自己的哪些替代历史。

paragraphs.en: Among the expansion rules, resampling gives the highest ALFWorld, mathematics, and WebShop scores, and RB the highest Search-QA SR (Table 8 ). Both rules change actions at similar rates, but resampling produces far fewer low-likelihood suffixes, 5.8% versus 19.2% (Table 9 ). paragraphs.en: A teacher whose own rollouts are clean can still reinforce repetition when queried on a repetitive student prefix; PBR targets these prefix-conditioned errors. On ALFWorld, teacher responses contain on average 1.64/1.50 excess leading </think> markers on ID/OOD. Vanilla OPD raises this to 1.94/1.91, and PBR reduces it to zero. A single response can contain several such markers.
paragraphs.zh: 即使一位教师的自身生成结果很干净，当被问及重复的学生前缀时，仍可能强化重复行为；PBR 针对这类受前缀影响而出现的错误。 在 ALFWorld 中，教师响应在 ID/OOD 情况下平均包含 1.64/1.50 个多余的开头 <think> 标记。 普通的 OPD 会将这一数值提升至 1.94/1.91，而 PBR 则将其降至零。 单个响应可能包含多个此类标记。

paragraphs.en: MATH contains competition problems in algebra, geometry, number theory, and related subjects ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) . paragraphs.en: ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ) is a text-based household environment that grounds language actions in embodied tasks. The agent reads textual observations and issues commands to navigate, inspect, pick up, place, and transform objects, and succeeds if it completes the goal within the step limit. We report success on 140 in-distribution (ID) and 134 out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks, and their unweighted mean. During branch training, the selected interaction state is restored, or the preceding actions are replayed, before generation continues from a token-level fork; observations serve as context and are not supervised.
paragraphs.zh: ALFWorld（Shridhar 等人，2020）是一个基于文本的家庭环境，它将语言行为与具身任务相联系。 智能体读取文本观察结果，并下达指令以导航、检查、拾取、放置和变换物体；若能在步数限制内完成目标，则视为成功。 我们报告了其在 140 个分布内（ID）任务和 134 个分布外（OOD）任务上的成功率，以及它们的无加权平均值。 在分支训练期间，在从词元级别的分支继续生成之前，会恢复所选的交互状态，或重播之前的动作；观察结果用作上下文，但不会受到监督。

paragraphs.en: Context distillation, self-distillation, and privileged supervision are other ways to transfer information into model parameters ( Ye et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Penaloza et al., 2026 ) . Recent work also studies reward extrapolation, skill transfer, hybrid supervision, and teacher retirement ( Yang et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026a ) . PPO and group-relative optimization are the underlying optimizers ( Schulman et al., 2017 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025 ) , and agent training systems such as GiGPO, ArCHer, Agent Lightning, WebRL, and Search-R1 optimize task rewards ( Feng et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Qi et al., 2024 ) , unlike the protocol-event loss used here. Our experiments use the Qwen3 and Qwen2.5 families, and Llama 3 is a related open model family ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; Qwen et al., 2024 ) . HybridFlow ( Sheng et al., 2024 ) , FlashAttention ( Dao et al., 2022 ) , and PagedAttention ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) improve execution and memory efficiency, complementing our reduction in generated student tokens. Continual on-policy distillation studies supervision and training distributions that change over time ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) ; our analysis instead fixes the rollout policy within each sampling group.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文蒸馏、自蒸馏和特权监督是将信息转移到模型参数中的其他方法（Ye 等人，2026；Zhao 等人，2026；Penaloza 等人，2026）。 近期的研究还探讨了奖励外推、技能迁移、混合监督和教师退休机制（Yang 等人，2026a；Wang 等人，2026a；Lu 等人，2026；Yu 等人，2026a）。 PPO 和群体相对优化是底层的优化器（Schulman 等人，2017；Shao 等人，2024；DeepSeek-AI 等人，2025），而 GiGPO、ArCHer、Agent Lightning、WebRL 和 Search-R1 等智能体训练系统则用于优化任务奖励（Feng 等人，2025；Zhou 等人，2024；Luo 等人，2025；Jin 等人，2025；Qi 等人，2024），这与本文使用的协议事件损失不同。 我们的实验使用了 Qwen3 和 Qwen2.5 系列模型，而 Llama 3 是一个相关的开源模型系列（Yang 等人，2025；Grattafiori 等人，2024；Qwen 等人，2024）。 HybridFlow（Sheng 等人，2024）、FlashAttention（Dao 等人，2022）和 PagedAttention（Kwon 等人，2023）提升了执行效率和内存效率，与我们减少生成学生令牌的做法形成了互补。 持续在线策略蒸馏研究的是随时间变化的监督分布和训练分布（Zheng 等人，2026）；而我们的分析则在每个采样组内固定了展开策略。
